titulo.alumno: Intermediate · Travel and accommodation: Reading and spelling

intro: T2 · Elementary · Understand the meaning and details of everyday written exchanges; understand notices, timetables and simple descriptive texts. Topic: Travel and accommodation. Focus: Reading and spelling.

texto: Reading and spelling of hotel terms: «โรงแรม» has two long vowels placed in front: โ (in front of ร, mid tone) and แ (in front of ร, mid tone). «จอง» has the mid-class consonant จ and the central vowel อ (mid tone). «ห้องพัก» combines «ห้อง» (falling tone) with «พัก» (low-class consonant พ with the short vowel ั and the final stop ก, high tone). «กระเป๋า» has «กระ» (low tone) and «เป๋า» with the sign ๋ (mái jattawaa) over the mid-class consonant ป, producing a clear rising tone.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «พนักงานต้อนรับของโรงแรมพร้อมให้ข้อมูลสถานที่ท่องเที่ยวและบริการเสริม» express?

opciones.texto: The reception staff offer tourist information and extra services.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «พนักงานต้อนรับของโรงแรมพร้อมให้ข้อมูลสถานที่ท่องเที่ยวและบริการเสริม» from the text.

opciones.texto: Storing your luggage safely in the room gives travellers peace of mind.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: The check-in and check-out conditions are stated on the booking voucher.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: In the word «กระเป๋า» (suitcase / luggage), which tone sign appears over the letter ป producing a rising tone?

opciones.texto: The sign ๋ (ไม้จัตวา)
opciones.explicacion: Correct: on mid-class consonants, the sign ๋ clearly produces a rising tone.
Incorrect: on mid-class consonants, mái eek produces a low tone.
Incorrect: on mid-class consonants, mái thoo produces a falling tone.
